SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P
File S.B. REGIST

S. 2, Special Branch,
Date February 19, 1935.

SECRET REPORT

Subject (in full) Alleged secret mission to Japan of Yamel Aref Malas,
Assyrian, French protege, on behalf of the Egyptian
Government.

Made by D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by S.B. Ros

At 6.30 a.m. Tuesday February 19, 1935 the under-
signed, D.S. Tcheremshansky and C.D.S. 48 were on duty at the
Wayside Wharf in order to meet the N.Y.K. s.s. 'Haruna Maru'
and to keep observation on Yamel Aref Malas who it was
reported would pass through Shanghai on a secret mission to
Japan on behalf of the Egyptian Government.

On arrival at the wharf careful enquiries were
instituted and it was learned that Yamel Aref Malas who
boarded the s.s. 'Haruna Maru' at Colombo described himself as
a missionary. He left the ship at Hongkong and when going
ashore was seen to be in possession of a French passport. He
travelled as a third class passenger and was heard to express
his intention of proceeding to Japan later by freight steamer.
He did not appear on the passenger list of persons booked to
Shanghai or Japan ports; it is therefore assumed that he booked
only to Hongkong.

（左侧批注：S.B. Ros. / copy A.A.）
（底部手写批注：Information required G.A. / DSR / D. S. I. / 19/2 S2. Please furnish copy / to party interested and place in / Reg. Office in Secret Drawer. / JAG）

秘密报告

主题（全称） 据称亚述人、法国受保护人 Yamel Aref Malas 代表埃及政府赴日本执行秘密任务。

报告人：副督察 Golder。呈报人：特务科 Ros

1935 年 2 月 19 日（星期二）上午 6 时 30 分，下述人员，即副督察 Tcheremshansky 和刑事侦缉警员 48 号，在汇山码头执勤，以便迎接日本邮船会社的“榛名丸”号轮船，并对 Yamel Aref Malas 进行监视。据报，此人将途经上海，代表埃及政府赴日本执行秘密任务。

抵达码头后，经仔细查问获悉，Yamel Aref Malas 在科伦坡登上“榛名丸”号轮船时自称是传教士。他在香港下船，上岸时被观察到持有一本法国护照。他乘坐三等舱，并被人听到表示打算日后搭乘货轮前往日本。他未出现在预订前往上海或日本各港口的乘客名单上；因此推测他仅预订了至香港的航程。

（左侧批注：特务科 Ros. / 副本送助理局长）
